title: A far converted layer's own map area reads and draws without REGISTRY_SOURCE_DENIED
cause: canonicalArea passed only context.area.siteId to canonicalCitations and revalidateCanonicalSources; registrySourceContextTx (and sourceBuildingOriginalAccessTx) compared it with the source's batch case site, which S9.5g keeps, so the own area answered 403 REGISTRY_SOURCE_DENIED (rehearsal 2 run 4, 3D-models-gml-medium-1).
rule: A source whose inspection.intakeOwnArea.areaId names the area being read is read for that area's site, and only when map_areas says that area has that site. The area id is an explicit optional argument; without it, or for any other site or area, the 403 and its words are unchanged.
readsChanged: registry-metadata.ts registrySourceContextTx(client, siteId, sourceId, areaId?) and registryDocumentSourceAccessTx (signature only): LEFT JOIN map_areas on the area being read

canonical-building.ts readSourceSha256, canonicalCitations and revalidateCanonicalSources take areaId; canonicalBuilding passes its area to the feature, height and retained-claim citations and to the revalidation
canonical-area.ts canonicalArea passes context.area.id to the building, base-feature, administrative-context and imagery citations and to the revalidation (GET /api/v1/areas/:areaId/canonical)
readsCheckedUnchanged: GET /areas, /areas/:id/context, /display-summary, /display-window and /import-packages/:id: no source site check beyond assertPackageDocumentAuthority and areaProposals, which S9.5g already made own-area aware
GET /buildings/:id (buildingDossier): reads revision>0 buildings only; dossierSources has no site check; packages pass assertRecordedPackageTx
canonical-building parcel refs, levels and spaces: recorded registry content only, left on the strict site check
raster citations (CANONICAL_RASTER_DENIED) and spatial-ml roofprint candidates: rasters record no intakeOwnArea
GET /buildings/:id/ledger (currentSourceProposal compares the package case site) and /buildings/:id/register: read by the card dialogs and the register, not when the map opens or draws an area
notChanged: No write path: saving, review, recording, packets, cards and the consolidated register keep their site checks (after the freeze). No contract change, no new SQL column (map_areas.site_id, area.sql).
